question: How should the existing two-channel AND safety decision coexist with a separate requirement to display two numerical upper confidence bounds with 95% simultaneous coverage?

decision_contract_preserved.name: intersection_union_decision
decision_contract_preserved.rule: release only if equal-process AND planned-exposure e-processes both cross threshold
decision_contract_preserved.reason: This is one intersection-union decision for the union unsafe null; splitting to .025/.025 would be an unnecessary power loss for that decision contract.

simultaneous_numeric_reporting_added.name: simultaneous_numeric_upper_bounds
simultaneous_numeric_reporting_added.reason: Union bound across the two numerical confidence sequences. This is a stricter reporting contract, not a correction to the valid decision-only IUT.

result.same_history_invariant: All four streams consume the exact same immutable journal-derived closed rows; recovery rebuilds every stream from those rows and compares a deterministic row digest.

synthetic_contract_validation.warning: The validation uses a self-contained conservative weighted Hoeffding CS and fixed-lambda e-process, not the production V3 water-filling family. Stopping times are wiring stress only, not V3 or deployment performance.
synthetic_contract_validation.interpretation: The reporting guarantee measurably widens bounds and delays a dual-bound safe report even though the original decision gate is unchanged. Reporting and decision validity should therefore remain separately named and measured.

rejected_generalizations: Do not split the existing AND decision alpha merely because two numeric bounds are also displayed.
Do not label two marginal 95% bounds as having 95% simultaneous coverage without an explicit joint-coverage construction.
Do not claim the synthetic Hoeffding stopping delays are production V3 performance.
Do not adapt the .025/.025 reporting alpha split after observing the same reliability history for free; any adaptive allocation requires an independently valid construction or separate meta-data.
Do not let reporting-mode state consume a different block history from decision-mode state; replay/live divergence invalidates the comparison.

frontier.action: Connect the wrapper to the actual production predictable-weight V3 factory and replay the exact canonical journal rows; verify zero changes to decision-IUT outputs and measure real V3 bound widening/stopping delay.
Using only precommitted or independent meta-data, compare unequal joint-report alpha allocations against .025/.025 for expected and worst-channel reporting delay; preserve sum alpha <= .05.

Add durable reporting snapshots keyed by canonical row digest so displayed simultaneous bounds can be audited independently from the decision-only release state without creating a second scientific history.
